scope: explicit versioned uninjured role resource profiles for ordinary flat equipment integration
provenance: designed transitions using client_verified current and maximum resource fields
authority: one persisted role resource state; naked growth attributes and final equipment projection do not each own HP/MP
carrier: explicitly migrate existing role_attribute_snapshots.vitals contract and record its new resource profile; never permanently dual-write another HP/MP ledger
injury_status: 640 equals final maxHP only for this explicitly uninjured profile; actual injury damage/recovery system is not implemented by this policy
equipment_transition: keep current absolute HP and MP; lower caps clip values; higher caps grant no resource; death remains0
ordinary_growth: same inventory/equipment basis; preserve missing HP/MP by adding the positive change in final caps; death remains0; ordinary growth cannot reduce caps
explicit_migration: known current HP/MP retained then clipped to current verified final caps; no inferred full heal or unknown legacy defaults
source_only_transition: same numeric caps and naked growth/basis/policies; inventory revision can advance; preserve current HP/MP and resource version; final caps must be computed from actual current assets
resource_values: trusted explicit resulting HP/MP within current final caps; these causes cannot revive a dead role
version: increment once when current HP/MP or numeric caps change; projection provenance-only changes retain resource version and still require full-snapshot CAS
projection_scope: role, naked baseline/growth revisions and attribute policy, current inventory revision, equipment basis revision and equipment policy
transaction: role lease caller transaction commits resource transition, assets/growth, fees and retry receipts together; encode final current snapshot before commit
reads_and_replays: read current state without resource transitions; paid command replays never repeat a cap change or heal
bounds: nonnegative signed32 resource values exactly representable by native float32; resource/source versions nonnegative signed63
combat_transition: designed ordinary physical terminal: trusted admitted battle result consumes current HP/MP only, keeps exact same caps and projection source, cannot heal or revive; role caller validates battle identity/version and atomically joins terminal state and settlement receipts before growth/rewards
activation: pure planner first; actual storage/consumers require explicit profile migration and unified resource Interface before opening ordinary six-slot caps
